title: Screen time and how you actually feel are two different things. Your screen time app only

copy.instagram_caption:
Your screen time report counts minutes. It doesn't count how you feel.

You've probably had ten minutes that left you rattled and an hour that left you fine.

We care about the part after. The tight jaw, the shallow breath, the buzz that follows you into whatever's next. DeRot helps you come back down from that.
